title: AI Strategist
description:
This role bridges enterprise data architecture and applied AI, defining how AI/ML technologies can automate metadata discovery, lineage analysis, and data-modernization planning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute an AI/ML strategy for automating metadata ingestion, lineage inference, and anomaly detection.

  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to embed Generative AI and predictive analytics into existing data-engineering processes.

  • Collaborate with data-engineering and architecture teams to integrate AI solutions within AWS and Azure ecosystems.

  • Assess, prototype, and recommend tools such as Azure AI Services, AWS SageMaker, Databricks ML, and OpenAI APIs.

  • Define long-term modernization and automation roadmaps; produce clear documentation and stakeholder presentations.

  • Establish governance and model-lifecycle best practices for AI components integrated into the data platform.
    Required Skills & Experience

  • 10–15 years overall experience, with 3–5 years in AI/ML strategy or enterprise data-modernization leadership.

  • Proven ability to design and implement AI-driven architectures for data-management or metadata initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of metadata management, data-lineage frameworks, and data-governance principles.

  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud AI platforms: Azure AI, AWS SageMaker, Databricks ML Flow, or comparable tools.

  • Experience defining AI roadmaps, proof-of-concepts, and ROI frameworks for large organizations.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication, executive reporting, and technical-writing skills.

    Nice to Have

  • Consulting background in AI advisory, data strategy, or digital-transformation programs.

  • Exposure to GenAI use cases for data quality, lineage inference, or ETL optimization.

  • Understanding of data-modernization tools (BladeBridge, Informatica IDMC, Collibra, Alation).

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Support the Data Engineering and AI Strategy teams by validating metadata ingestion outputs, analyzing lineage completeness, and creating Power BI reports that summarize lineage coverage and modernization insights for business and technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze metadata and lineage results to detect data-flow gaps, unused or orphan tables, and anomalies.

  • Perform data reconciliation between source and target systems to validate completeness and accuracy of ingestion.

  • Create and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that visualize lineage coverage, ETL health, and modernization metrics.

  • Document lineage findings, data-quality issues, and remediation recommendations.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to enhance lineage logic and with the AI Strategist on modernization insights.

  • Verify deployment readiness by ensuring that ingestion logic aligns with production datasets and metadata standards.

Required Skills:

8+ years in data analysis, data operations, or metadata validation roles with proven experience in Power BI and SQL-based lineage/QA work.

  • Power BI – advanced report building, DAX expressions, and data-model creation.

  • SQL – strong query writing, joins, aggregations, and set-based validation logic.

  • Excel / Python (pandas) – for ad-hoc analysis, lineage comparison, and quick statistical validation.

  • Understanding of ETL flows (Informatica, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory) and job scheduling dependencies.

  • Metadata / lineage tools – exposure to Collibra, Alation, or custom metadata repositories.

  • Data documentation and QA discipline – ability to trace and explain data-flow logic clearly.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with AWS Glue Catalog, Azure Synapse, or BladeBridge lineage outputs.

  • Knowledge of Client Batch Processing concepts.

  • Exposure to data-modernization or cloud migration initiatives.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and enhance data ingestion pipelines and metadata frameworks that support data lineage, modernization, and analytics enablement.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with AWS Glue, Python/PySpark, ETL pipelines, and metadata management tools, with the ability to work in a dynamic, cloud-centric data environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data ingestion and ETL pipelines for metadata integration across systems like SQL Server, Informatica, AWS Glue, and Azure Data Factory.

  • Implement end-to-end data lineage tracing, including source-to-target mapping, column-level lineage, and job dependency tracking.

  • Automate metadata ingestion and transformation for lineage reporting and quality validation.

  • Identify static, orphaned, or unused tables/jobs and contribute to data-quality improvement.

  • Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and AI strategist to align metadata ingestion with modernization goals.

  • Participate in the deployment and hardening of solutions in AWS (and Azure as applicable).

  • Contribute to modernization and AI-readiness initiatives through metadata standardization and automation.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 8–10 years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL Development.

  • Strong experience with:

    • AWS Glue, S3, Redshift, Lambda

    • SQL (SQL Server, Oracle, or Snowflake) – complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning

    • Python / PySpark for metadata parsing and ETL automation

    • ETL Tools: Informatica, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory

    • Data Lineage / Metadata Management: Collibra, Alation, or custom lineage repositories

    • CI/CD & Orchestration: GitHub, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps

Nice to Have

  • Experience with BladeBridge or similar lineage analysis tools

  • Familiarity with Client Batch Processing

  • Exposure to Airflow, dbt, or Databricks for orchestration and transformation

  • Basic understanding of AI/ML data pipeline readiness

  • Azure data platform exposure (ADF, Synapse, Data Lake)

title: SOC Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct detailed investigations of security incidents — from data collection to root cause analysis and recovery — ensuring compliance with defined SLAs.
  • Validate and fine-tune SIEM correlation rules, custom detections, and use cases to minimize false positives and enhance detection accuracy.
  • Propose and develop new SIEM use cases and automated playbooks aligned with emerging threats and evolving TTPs.
  • Review alert quality regularly, enhancing or retiring outdated detection logic and improving response strategies.
  • Mentor and support L1 analysts to build stronger detection and response capabilities.
  • Continuously monitor SIEM and other security tools to identify potential threats, anomalies, or policy violations.
  • Lead end-to-end incident response activities — focusing on threat containment, eradication, and ensuring forensic integrity.
  • Correlate data across multiple sources to generate actionable intelligence and identify complex attack patterns.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and SMEs to quickly resolve technical and security issues.
  • Analyze logs, metrics, and behaviors to detect early indicators of compromise.
  • Document incidents, root causes, and remediation steps while refining playbooks and response procedures.
  • Share insights and threat intelligence to promote continuous learning across the SOC team.
  • Keep leadership informed of high-severity incidents and recommend tactical or strategic countermeasures.
  • Ensure all SOC processes adhere to organizational policies, compliance standards, and industry best practices.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in Information Security, SOC Operations, or Incident Response.
  • Solid understanding of cybersecurity frameworks — MITRE Telecommunication&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, NIST IR.
  • Strong expertise in Cloud Security, EDR, SIEM, and Firewall technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of networking and security fundamentals (OS internals, TCP/IP, IDS/IPS, ports, etc.).
  • Experience with malware analysis and sandbox environments.
  • Ability to interpret complex alerts/logs and translate findings into actionable remediation steps.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and leadership.
